notes.title: Demo v0.4.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]✨ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Mouse wheel zooming is now centered around the mouse cursor instead of the center of the screen, so you can point-and-zoom and it will magnify the area where you are pointing.[/p][/*][*][p]Magnify and pan gestures are now supported (e.g. from a MacBook trackpad).[/p][/*][/list][h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][i]Demolish Everything[/i] button is no longer clickable while it is hidden (the keyboard shortcut continues to works regardless of the button visibility).[/p][/*][*][p]When going to the settings menu or main menu while Demolish mode is active, the cursor now changes back from the demolish cursor to the regular mouse cursor.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠️ Internal Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The game engine has been upgraded to Godot 4.4.1, bringing some upstream performance improvements and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]✨ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]The number of daily delivered parcels is now visible even in Chill Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon and Gravity Well descriptions had their wording updated to better explain what the buildings can and cannot do.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial has been updated to mention that Freeze buttons also freeze upgrade costs between days.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Font issues on the Steam Deck have been fixed. This involved disabling fallback to system fonts on all platforms, so please let us know if you encounter any other font-rendering issues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]🖼️ Visual Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Days now begin and end at noon instead of at midnight -- we have heard your feedback that the lighting and shadows look a lot better during the day and people spend a lot of time in the paused state at the end of one day and the start of another, and of course we would like to present the game in the best [i]light.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Shadow quality was improved, especially on the Arctic Shores biome.[/p][/*][*][p]Soft shadow quality can now be configured in the settings.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] ❄️Arctic Shores modifier that makes a building type cheaper (🛷🔨Sledge Hammers) now properly works with other cost-reducing upgrades (sorry, no more free [strike]lunch[/strike] hammers!)[/p][/*][*][p] 🛷🔨Sledge Hammers cost reductions are now factored into hammer return previews inside the Shop[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4.3 Patch Notes – ❄️ Snow biome, Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes: [h2]Demo v0.4.3 Patch Notes[/h2][p][i]Now live during Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/i][/p][p][i]We've also published a brand new Gameplay Trailer that focuses on the core gameplay loop, check it out, [/i][i][strike]turtles 🐢[/strike][/i][i] puffins all the way down.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]✨ New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]❄️ Snow biome now unlockable[/b] by beating Grassy Cliffs ⛰️ – includes new modifiers like Sledge Hammers🛷🔨 and Permafrost for diverse gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565274/701269e45dbdb0235600064d12ac0c376f9ace74.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Stats Menu added![/b] Track your stamp upgrade collections, active modifiers, and game statistics[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565274/befbdcfb13d8c6e56fc57f645d24d5a6d4b47bc0.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎨 Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Better level selection with clearer unlock and progression tracking[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI polish and positioning improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="2KuxW-Z0qTQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo v0.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]✨ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]New Cannon upgrade, Ammozone Prime, lets Cannons load parcels directly from neighboring buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Each building and upgrade now has a fancy icon and upgrades have an assigned upgrade type[/p][/*][*][p]Building names are now color-coded in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Redundant tooltips were removed from the shop[/p][/*][/list][h2]⚖️ Balancing Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Higher Cannon base fire rate (0.6 -> 1.0)[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon fire rate increase from Fire at Will is stronger (0.1 -> 0.15)[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon upgrade Giddy Gunners weaker (80% -> 50%) but cheaper[/p][/*][*][p]Higher Gravity Well base pull speed (0.3 -> 0.5)[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon and Gravity Well upgrades are now generally cheaper[/p][/*][/list][h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Some path finding fixes and optimizations, slight efficiency improvements when multiple parallel parcel paths exist[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]✨ Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the shop with smoother animations and additional sound effects
[*] Added helpful tooltips to top-level UI elements (stamp & hammer counters, parcel progress bars)
[*] New option to show FPS available in Interface Settings for performance monitoring
[/list]

[h2]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]

[/list]
